title_en: Fall 2026 Korean Language Examination for International Students' Thesis Submission Qualification
summary: Graduate international students must pass the foreign language examination of the Thesis Submission Qualification Examination by choosing one of three methods: taking the Korean language test, completing a designated Korean language course, or submitting an English test score. Applications for the Korean language test and English score reports must be submitted to the School Administration Office (Building 301, Room 319) between 24 and 28 August 2026. The written Korean language test will be held on 18 September 2026 at 9:30 in Building 39, Room B103.
applies_to: Graduate international (foreign) students who must pass the foreign language examination of the Thesis Submission Qualification Examination; each student must satisfy it by one of the three methods. Integrated master's-doctoral program students take the test as doctoral program candidates. The English score option is only for international students whose native, common or official language is not English; students whose native, common or official language is English may only take the Korean language test or the Korean language course.

dates.what: Korean language test is held each semester (organised by the Seoul National University Office of Academic Affairs)
dates.when: Every semester in March and September

conditions: You need to complete only one of the three methods: Korean language test, Korean language course, or English score submission.
The Korean test application form must bear your own signature and your supervisor's signature or seal (stamp).
You must bring your student ID card or an identification card (alien registration card) to the test.
You must be seated in your assigned seat at the test venue by 9:20.
Integrated master's-doctoral program students take the test as doctoral program candidates.
If you wish to take the oral Korean language test instead, contact the department office by email (contact details are in the original notice).
Credits from the Korean language courses are not counted toward completion credits.
A grade of C- or higher, or S, in the Korean language course exempts you from the Korean language test.
The Korean language course must be taken before the semester in which you complete your coursework (수료).
The English score option is available only to students whose native, common or official language is not English.
Students whose native, common or official language is English may only take the Korean language test or the Korean language course.
Accepted English tests are New TEPS and TOEFL (iBT), and the score report must be within its two-year validity period.
Minimum English scores are set out in Attachment 2, which was not read and is not included here.

translation:
★ Fall 2026 (2026-2 semester) Korean Language Examination for International Students' Thesis Submission Qualification Examination

Announcement of the Foreign Language Examination for International Students' Thesis Submission Qualification (Including Korean)

To pass the foreign language examination of the Thesis Submission Qualification Examination, graduate international students may choose one of the following three methods.

I. Take the Korean language test: organised by the Seoul National University Office of Academic Affairs every semester in March and September.
II. Take a Korean language course: [한국어와 한국문화1] (Korean Language and Korean Culture 1) or [한국어와 한국문화2] (Korean Language and Korean Culture 2).
III. Submit an English score: New TEPS, TOEFL (iBT).

I. Taking the Korean language test
Refer to Attachment 1 (2026-2 Semester Korean Language Test Plan and Application Form).

1. Submitting the application form
A. Submission period: Monday 24 August 2026 – Friday 28 August 2026 ★ Check the dates!!
B. Submission method: Complete and print the application form (see Attachment 1) → sign it yourself and obtain your supervisor's signature (or seal) → submit it to the staff member in charge at the School Administration Office (학부행정실) (Building 301, Room 319).

2. Korean language test (written examination)
A. Test date: Friday 18 September 2026, 9:30–10:30 (60 minutes). ※ Be seated in your assigned seat at the test venue by 9:20.
B. Test venue: Building 39, Room B103.

3. Notes
A. Bring your student ID card or an identification card (alien registration card).
B. Integrated master's-doctoral program students take the test as doctoral program candidates.
※ If you wish to take the Korean language test as an oral examination, please enquire by email (the address is in the original notice).

II. Taking a Korean language course
1. You take a course that substitutes for the Thesis Submission Qualification Examination. However, its credits are not included in completion credits.
2. Course names: [한국어와 한국문화 1] (Korean Language and Korean Culture 1), [한국어와 한국문화 2] (Korean Language and Korean Culture 2).
3. If you obtain a grade of "C- or higher" or "S", you are exempted from the Korean language test.
※ The course must be taken before the semester in which you complete your coursework (수료).

III. Submitting an English score
Refer to Attachment 2 (English Minimum Scores for the Thesis Submission Qualification Examination).
1. International students whose native language, common language or official language is not English submit their English test score report to the staff member in charge at the School Administration Office (Building 301, Room 319).
★ The score must not have passed its validity period (within 2 years).
2. English score report submission period: Monday 24 August 2026 – Friday 28 August 2026 ★ Check the dates!!
3. Minimum scores: see Attachment 2!!
4. International students whose native language, common language or official language is English may only take the Korean language test or the Korean language course.

1. 2026-2 Semester Korean Language Test Plan and Application Form (2026-2학기 한국어시험 실시 계획(공지용).hwp)
2. English Minimum Scores for the Thesis Submission Qualification Examination (논문제출자격시험 영어과목 기준 점수.pdf)
